text:
Tech-West England Advocates (TWEA) is the West of England group of the Global Tech Advocates (GTA) network, founded by Richard Lowe. It is a volunteer-led community that supports tech founders and scale-ups across the West of England, the South West and the West Midlands, and connects them with partners, investors and international markets.
What we do: events and founder clinics; international trade missions (e.g. the UK Tech Mission to the Greater Bay Area, China, Nov 2026, and the New Horizons Health Tech Mission to Boston, Apr 2027, led by TWEA); sector ambassadors (e.g. Chris Born, HealthTech Ambassador); and a quarterly newsletter. Partners have included DSIT/the Department for Business and Trade, the University of the West of England, UK Tech Advocates and Tech London Advocates & Global Tech Advocates.
2027 priorities (announced after the GTA Summit Istanbul 2026): stronger support for regional and UK scale-ups, and connecting more capital to ambitious founders, especially at Series A and beyond, through the GTA Innovation Funding Working Group.
Founder skills we want to fund: pitching and investment readiness, practical AI and automation, international growth, and fair access for under-represented founders.
